mandi_processing_001: Please wait a moment. The latest market prices for your selected crop and mandi are being fetched.
mandi_price_alert_001: Attention. There has been a significant change in the market price of your selected crop. Please check the current price and market situation before deciding to sell.
mandi_replay_001: Let me guide you again. First select your crop, then choose the mandi. After that, you will see the latest mandi prices, price changes, and important information related to selling.
mandi_welcome_001: Welcome to the Mandi Prices page. Here you can get the latest market prices, price changes, and important selling information for your crops across different mandis.
mandi_result_001: Mandi prices fetched successfully. Minimum price, maximum price, average price, and other important market information are shown on your screen. Please check all information carefully before deciding to sell.
mandi_offline_001: No internet right now. If recent mandi prices are available on your device, they will be shown. Please connect to the internet for the latest information.
mandi_error_001: Sorry. Mandi prices could not be fetched right now. Please check your internet connection and try again after some time.
mandi_crop_selection_001: Please select the crop whose mandi price you want to check. After selecting the right crop, the latest market prices from related mandis will be shown.
mandi_exit_001: Thank you for using the Mandi Prices feature. You can check prices for other crops too or use other features of the app. I will keep guiding you on the next page too.
mandi_market_selection_001: Now select your preferred mandi. After selection, the latest prices, price changes, and other market information for that mandi will be shown.
mandi_help_001: Please select your crop and mandi. After that, you will see the latest prices, minimum and maximum values, and other required information for that mandi.
